prediction_unit: eligible OSM intersection node by week
intended_use: Research screening and prioritization for follow-up road-safety analysis.
not_intended_for: Automatic engineering decisions, causal claims, enforcement decisions, or replacement of professional review.
known_limitations: Traffic and pedestrian exposure are not directly modeled.
Reported crashes may contain reporting and location error.
Current OSM tags may not represent historical road conditions.
Neighborhood features share crash history between nearby intersections, so adjacent rankings are not independent.
Validation and test cover about two years each; performance can drift as reporting practices change.
